picks.title: Marine Microalgal Genes: Unlocking a New Era of Sustainable High Value PUFA Production for Neuroprotective Applications.
picks.hook: Marine microalgal genes are harnessed to boost sustainable production of neuroprotective omega‑3 PUFA for high‑value nutraceuticals.

picks.title: Low-temperature plasma technology: comprehensive applications in microalgae cultivation, mutagenesis, and downstream processing.
picks.hook: Low‑temperature plasma is showcased for boosting microalgae growth, inducing beneficial mutations, and streamlining downstream processing.

picks.title: Beyond conventional imaging: curvelet-AI convergence for non-invasive microalgal lipid quantification and biofuel optimization.
picks.hook: A curvelet‑AI imaging pipeline enables non‑invasive lipid quantification, accelerating biofuel optimization in microalgal cultures.

picks.title: Oral Microalgae-Laden Hydrogels Modulating the Intestinal Microbiota Metabolism for Acute Alcohol-Induced Liver Injury Therapy.
picks.hook: Oral microalgae‑laden hydrogels reshape gut microbiota metabolism, offering a novel therapy for acute alcohol‑induced liver injury.
